tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: The deepest ground: the stage behind the preview, input wells, timeline lanes. Nothing is darker.

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Page background of every marketing and account page; the editor's rail and timeline ground.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the app bar, the inspector.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: Raised controls on a panel: secondary buttons, menus, toasts, the floating toolbar.

tokens.name: bg-4
tokens.usage: Hovered or pressed control, the active segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: fill-1
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows and ghost controls.

tokens.name: fill-2
tokens.usage: Pressed wash, neutral badge ground, the value fill of an idle scrub field.

tokens.name: line-1
tokens.usage: Hairlines between regions and around cards. Decorative: never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Borders of controls at rest (inputs, secondary buttons, menus).

tokens.name: line-3
tokens.usage: Hovered control border, dashed drop-zone outline, switch track when off.

tokens.name: ink-1
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every bg token.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, body copy on marketing pages, control labels. On bg-0 to bg-4.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: hints, metadata, inactive tabs, placeholders. On bg-0 to bg-3 (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Non-text marks only: unlit jacks and keyframe diamonds, unplayed waveform, drag grips. Never text.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary action per view (Open the editor, Export).

tokens.name: cta-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered primary action.

tokens.name: on-cta
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a cta fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lit, selected, playing: the playhead, selected layer, active tab, focus, switch on. As text on bg-0 to bg-3.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered accent fill or link.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind a selected row or an active scrub field; carries accent or ink-1 text.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Border of a selected row or a featured card on accent-soft.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent fill.

tokens.name: sig-bass
tokens.usage: Everything patched to the bass signal: jack, chip, modulation bar, layer dot, meter.

tokens.name: sig-mid
tokens.usage: Everything patched to the mids.

tokens.name: sig-high
tokens.usage: Everything patched to the highs.

tokens.name: sig-level
tokens.usage: Everything patched to overall loudness.

tokens.name: sig-beat
tokens.usage: Everything patched to the beat; beat ticks on the timeline.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Finished render, saved state. Always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Unsaved changes, files that expire, queue is long. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors, as text and icon on bg tokens or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a destructive button or error banner.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border on danger-soft.

tokens.name: premium
tokens.usage: Premium only: the lock on a gated option, the Premium badge, the upgrade button. Never decoration.

tokens.name: premium-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a Premium badge, banner or upgrade button.

tokens.name: premium-line
tokens.usage: Border on premium-soft.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and the mobile menu.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Make your music impossible to scroll past.
styles.usage: Landing hero headline, desktop. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section headlines on marketing pages; hero headline on phones at 40px.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Card titles on marketing pages, dialog titles on auth pages.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Drop in a track, pick a 3D scene and export a video that moves on every beat.
styles.usage: Hero and section lead paragraphs, in ink-2.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The video is drawn by the same code as the preview.
styles.usage: Marketing body copy, FAQ answers, legal pages.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog and popover titles, dashboard section titles.

styles.name: ui
styles.sample: Click an element to select it.
styles.usage: The editor's base size: menus, buttons, inputs, toasts.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, card names, selected items.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Files are deleted after three days.
styles.usage: Hints, metadata, control labels inside the inspector.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Badges, signal chips, rail labels. The smallest text allowed.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Every number the user can change: scrub field values, hex colours, percentages.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Transport time, render progress, ruler labels (at 10px).

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a marketing section and menu group labels. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its badge, inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its neighbour; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inspector side padding, card body padding in the editor.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter, gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Marketing card padding, desktop gutter, nav side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a section headline and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between hero copy and hero picture.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Thumbnails in rows, kbd keys, colour chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Scrub fields, segments, menu items, small buttons, the video frame.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, rail items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Editor cards, menus, toasts, the floating toolbar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Marketing cards, dialogs, drop zones, the app window.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, signal chips, filter chips, switches, the play button.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Raised controls: secondary button, active segment.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Things that float over the editor: menus, popovers, toasts, the toolbar.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the app window on the landing page.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: the stage, timeline lanes.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: The current template card and the selected keyframe. At most one glowing thing per region.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a solid accent ring with a bg-1 gap.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons and layer row actions.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default control height in the editor.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Controls on account and auth pages, nav buttons.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Hero and closing call-to-action buttons.

tokens.name: appbar-h
tokens.usage: Height of the editor's app bar.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Width of the editor's icon rail.

tokens.name: library-w
tokens.usage: Default width of the editor's library panel (resizable 240 to 400).

tokens.name: inspector-w
tokens.usage: Default width of the editor's inspector (resizable 280 to 440).

tokens.name: timeline-h
tokens.usage: Default height of the timeline (resizable 120 to 480).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on marketing pages.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky nav, the editor's app bar.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.
